input.summary: Add HDI performance and conformance warranty with a real remedy
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 contains only corporate authority representations, with no warranty covering the development, hosting or availability of the Site. We have added a workmanlike-performance and conformance warranty with compliance with law, no malicious code, and re-performance/repair/refund as our remedy.

ops.text: (c) HDI warrants that (1) the design, development, hosting, operation and maintenance of the Site will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards and in compliance with all applicable laws; (2) for a period of twelve (12) months following the Effective Date, the Site will conform in all material respects to the specifications and Content approved by the Company under Section 5.2 and will be available on demand to Internet users other than during scheduled maintenance; and (3) the Site and any software provided by HDI will be free of viruses and other malicious code. The Company's remedy for breach of this warranty shall be, at HDI's option, prompt re-performance, repair or replacement, or a refund of amounts paid by the Company relating to the non-conforming services.

input.summary: Insert HDI insurance covenant in the General Provisions
input.comment: [Playbook] HDI hosts our branded Site and processes our customer data, so standard coverage is required; we have added our baseline CGL, E&O and cyber limits with certificates on request.

ops.text: 10.9 Insurance. HDI shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than $1,000,000 per occurrence and $2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than $2,000,000; and, for so long as HDI processes Company customer data, cyber liability insurance of not less than $5,000,000. HDI shall maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law and shall provide certificates of insurance to the Company on request.

input.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance and data return obligations
input.comment: [Playbook] Nothing addresses wind-down even though HDI holds our Site and customer data. We have added six months of transition assistance at HDI's then-current rates, return of our data in machine-readable form within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter.

ops.text: 4.3 Transition Assistance; Return of Data. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) at the Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance, including cooperation in migrating the Site to the Company or its designee, for up to six (6) months at HDI's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days, return to the Company all Content, customer, order and user data and other Company Confidential Information in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing. HDI shall not delete, withhold or suspend access to Company data as a means of enforcing payment or other obligations.
